scope.notes: Confirmed V1 scope; the reference wave count does not force every level to have eight waves.

rage.engagedDefinition: One shared whole-army engagement flag: at least one damaging camp or hero has an alive attackable enemy in valid basic-attack range. Each hero then accrues rage once using its own role rate; aura camps and invulnerable targets alone do not create engagement.
rage.formula: for each hero: rage=min(100,rage+roleRate(sharedArmyEngaged)*unblockedCombatDt); roleRate uses lead/support; unblockedCombatDt=max(0,dt-min(dt,recoveryRemaining)); recoveryRemaining=max(0,recoveryRemaining-dt)

economy.referenceFinalBudgetEnemyPattern: prototype snapshot composition scaled by V1 density once for nonboss enemies, V1 base rewards, one unscaled boss; arithmetic reference only
economy.lateFullFieldPolicy: Late all-kill income may fund a full field; income timing, camp mix and level-three priorities remain tradeoffs. Full camps must not replace hero ultimates; validate rather than claim a hard cash deficit on every stage.
economy.rewardRevision: infantry stays 1; cavalry and elites/boss have lower integer rewards to temper density-related inflation
economy.referenceEnemyCompositionSource: historical 619-enemy training pattern before this density revision; independent of the current prototypeSnapshot

modifierRules.slowFactors: Strongest applicable factor wins, respecting class resistance and minimum speed factor; no additive freeze.
modifierRules.tacticScope: Only the selected hero or matching camp type; no implicit whole-army damage boost.

archer.rule: A cycle contains the main and volley projectiles; cap secondary pierce hits across the entire cycle.

modifierRules.slowResistanceRule: apply ordinary/elite/boss fraction and siege control fraction once; take strongest effective factor, never multiply independent slows

equipment.signatureNamingPolicy: Historical fiction and original wargame equipment; names are thematic, not claims of historical ownership.

metaProgression.normalLevelRequirement: Each level must be clearable at the recommended minimum hero and skill levels plus the recommended minimum main weapon only, with other three slots white Lv0, without daily repeat grinding. Initial resources are explicitly zero; initial tutorial levels are hero Lv1, skill Lv1, white Lv0.
metaProgression.recommendedTrainingPlan: First-clear campaign rewards fund a selected three-hero core; all fifteen heroes at maximum is optional long-term collection, not a clearance prerequisite.

starsReward.formula: rewardDelta=(firstWin?baseReward:0)+sum(floor(baseReward*0.1) for bonus star in [2,3] where previousHighestStar<star<=newHighestStar)

skillQueue.notes: Rage is the real cooldown. Reserving prevents duplicate clicks; rejected/cancelled queued requests never consume rage or enter recovery. Boss invulnerability blocks auto casting, and presentation scheduling never grants extra combat time.

v1Baseline.stageGrowthTierAssignment: Wei then Shu then Wu: explicit globalIndex 1..60, S01..S12 each bind five consecutive formal levels. The prototype training encounter is outside these sixty levels; replay does not reset tiers or reward flags. Never scale enemies from the actual selected hero level or equipment.

controlAndDisruption.enemyControlRule: multiply class resistance and siege control fraction once; strongest independent effective slow only

v1Baseline.bossVariantMultiplierPolicy: bossVariant.hpMultiplier contains the chapter act factor (0.75/0.82/0.90/1/1.12) and any explicitly documented variant adjustment. Do not apply bossActHpMultipliers again at runtime. No automatic wave-index HP growth.

battleSpeed.combatDtFormula: combatDt=visibleWallDt*battleSpeed; advance through fixed small substeps without dropping accumulated combat time
battleSpeed.speedChangeRule: Change only future wall-to-combat conversion; preserve timers, rage, queues and pending fixed steps.

alphaBalanceRevision.reason: Keep low-frequency capped area camps; reduce compounded elite durability and cavalry speed so earned-food control leaves room for hero ultimates.
alphaBalanceRevision.verifiedPolicy: mode6 two shields, one elite-priority crossbow, remaining archers; stage minimum training and main weapon only
alphaBalanceRevision.scope: 60 configured seeds and legal fixed policy; not proof that every party or player timing wins

upgrades.description: 盾营控制范围增加25

upgrades.name: 破阵反击
upgrades.description: 盾营每次攻击最多命中5名敌人

upgrades.name: 拒马连环
upgrades.description: 盾营减速范围内的敌人，受到其他军营的伤害增加15%

upgrades.name: 陷阵之志
upgrades.description: 盾营范围内每有10名敌人，本营伤害增加8%，最多增加80%
upgrades.runtimeNotes: 本卡为稀有军营专精，每10名范围内敌人提供8%伤害、最多80%；该增益与普通和稀有属性卡的军营伤害加法池相加。

upgrades.name: 铁壁军令
upgrades.description: 盾营减速下限降低至0.22，对精锐的减速效果额外增加15%

upgrades.name: 八门金锁阵
upgrades.description: 进入盾营范围的敌人定身1秒，每名敌人每6秒最多触发一次

upgrades.name: 霹雳巨石
upgrades.description: 投石爆炸半径增加12

upgrades.name: 碎石封路
upgrades.description: 投石落点附加35%减速，持续2.5秒

upgrades.name: 摧城破甲
upgrades.description: 投石对重甲与首领伤害增加25%

upgrades.name: 火油弹
upgrades.description: 投石爆炸区域留下火场，每秒造成12点伤害，持续3秒

upgrades.name: 天崩地裂
upgrades.description: 无尽模式投石爆炸伤害最多命中的目标由6名增加至10名

upgrades.name: 连发投石
upgrades.description: 投石营攻击间隔缩短18%

upgrades.name: 霹雳连车
upgrades.description: 每次投石追加一枚70%伤害的石弹，瞄准随机另一目标；爆炸半径增加10

upgrades.name: 贯甲强弩
upgrades.description: 弩营对精锐与首领额外增伤25%，与基础精锐增伤乘算

upgrades.name: 穿阵劲矢
upgrades.description: 弩矢贯穿一名敌军，造成35%伤害

upgrades.name: 瞭望校射
upgrades.description: 弩营射程增加25

upgrades.name: 破甲锥
upgrades.description: 弩矢命中攻城车或首领时，额外造成其最大生命值3%的伤害
upgrades.runtimeNotes: 最大生命3%作为独立附伤，不被弩营基础精锐倍率、科技或贯甲强弩放大；穿阵劲矢的35%伤害分支只携带35%的该附伤，附伤继续受敌方易伤与减免影响。

upgrades.name: 连弩机关
upgrades.description: 弩营攻击间隔缩短20%，达到5级时额外缩短5%

upgrades.name: 神射营
upgrades.description: 弩营每击杀一名敌人，下次攻击伤害增加80%，最多积蓄三层
upgrades.runtimeNotes: 本卡为稀有军营专精，发射时快照并消耗本营积蓄层数，每层增加80%伤害、最多三层；该增益与普通和稀有属性卡的军营伤害加法池相加。

upgrades.name: 蹶张神射
upgrades.description: 弩营优先命中当前血量最高的敌人，并使其受到的所有伤害增加18%

upgrades.name: 泼油成阵
upgrades.description: 火油营的火场半径增加16

upgrades.name: 烈火炙甲
upgrades.description: 对精锐与首领灼烧伤害增加15%

upgrades.name: 泥油阻路
upgrades.description: 火油命中附加25%减速，持续1秒

upgrades.name: 膏油猛火
upgrades.description: 火油营火场半径增加25，每跳伤害增加25%
upgrades.runtimeNotes: 本卡为史诗军营专精，每跳伤害提高25%形成独立乘区倍率1.25，与普通和稀有属性卡的伤害加法池分开结算。

upgrades.name: 火势蔓延
upgrades.description: 火油营火场持续时间延长1.5秒

upgrades.name: 焦土
upgrades.description: 敌人离开火场后持续燃烧2秒，每秒受到火油每跳伤害50%的伤害

upgrades.name: 余烬燎原
upgrades.description: 火场内敌人受到的所有伤害增加20%，同一火油营可同时维持两个火场

upgrades.name: 鼓声远传
upgrades.description: 战鼓光环范围增加30

upgrades.name: 振军奋勇
upgrades.description: 战鼓攻速增益增加5%，受当前攻速上限约束

upgrades.name: 整军固守
upgrades.description: 鼓声范围内军营获得25%扰阵抗性

upgrades.name: 一鼓作气
upgrades.description: 无尽模式战鼓攻速加成上限由30%提高至45%

upgrades.name: 三通鼓
upgrades.description: 战鼓光环内每有一个军营，攻速增益额外增加2%，最多增加12%

upgrades.name: 战意昂扬
upgrades.description: 战鼓光环内武将的普攻攻速增加12%

upgrades.name: 鼓角齐鸣
upgrades.description: 光环内军营伤害增加15%；每次无双释放时，光环增益翻倍并持续5秒
upgrades.runtimeNotes: 翻倍鼓源的攻速、伤害及武将普攻光环加成，包括5级、科技与振军奋勇；不翻倍范围或持续时间，仍受当前无尽局部30%或45%上限约束；其他武将提供的加速与射程效果不属于鼓源。

taoyuan.name: 桃园结义
taoyuan.runtimeNotes: 三人全部上阵时激活。完整无双怒气循环缩短15%：个人恢复期乘0.85，普通怒气获取率除0.85，不修改剧情默认值。

weiwu_xiongfeng.name: 魏武雄风
weiwu_xiongfeng.runtimeNotes: 五名魏将任选三名。增伤按敌方精锐或首领条件判定，也作用于破甲锥独立百分比附伤；不会更改敌兵基础或人数倍率。

jiangdong_huchen.name: 江东虎臣
jiangdong_huchen.runtimeNotes: 五名吴将任选两名。火与箭类无双的范围增益只作用于周瑜、甘宁和太史慈；江东之力还要求周瑜与甘宁同时上阵。

wolong_zhonghu.name: 卧龙冢虎
wolong_zhonghu.runtimeNotes: 诸葛亮与司马懿均在队时激活；对减速目标的1.2倍增伤与谋定天下的风、雷两个易伤来源独立结算。可与三势力四方来朝同时成立。

synergyUpgrades.name: 义结金兰
synergyUpgrades.description: 桃园三人中任一人释放无双时，另外两人各获得15点怒气
synergyUpgrades.runtimeNotes: 只奖励该羁绊的另外两名成员；怒气遵守各自当前怒气上限。

synergyUpgrades.name: 虎豹骑锋
synergyUpgrades.description: 魏武雄风成员的无双可以斩杀血量低于60%的步兵
synergyUpgrades.runtimeNotes: 仅针对步兵且保留executeImmune规则，不削弱原有无双已经具备的步兵斩杀；不更改其他兵种。

synergyUpgrades.name: 江东之力
synergyUpgrades.description: 周瑜火带内的敌人受到甘宁箭雨伤害增加30%
synergyUpgrades.runtimeNotes: 除江东虎臣外还要求周瑜与甘宁同时在队，避免没有对应技能时出现无效牌。只对真实处于周瑜火带内的甘宁箭雨命中生效。

synergyUpgrades.name: 谋定天下
synergyUpgrades.description: 幽雷命中附加持续3秒的1.2倍易伤，并可与风牢易伤相乘
synergyUpgrades.runtimeNotes: 现行司马懿本体没有易伤，本卡补上雷击1.2倍、3秒来源。风雷两来源为1.2乘1.2等于1.44；出师表的风1.5时为1.8。卧龙冢虎本身对减速目标的1.2倍仍另行乘算。

synergyUpgrades.name: 三人同心
synergyUpgrades.description: 三人满编时，全军伤害增加12%
synergyUpgrades.runtimeNotes: 本卡为稀有强化，12%并入现有全军伤害加法池；属于己方普通伤害成长，不放大破甲锥独立百分比附伤。

synergyUpgrades.name: 合击精通
synergyUpgrades.description: 合击窗口由2秒延长至4秒，每局合击上限由3次提高至5次
synergyUpgrades.runtimeNotes: 依正文可在任意编队进入候选；窗口使用战斗时间，每局总上限由所有八组合击共享。

synergyUpgrades.name: 同袍之谊
synergyUpgrades.description: 至少两名同势力武将在队时，该势力武将怒气获取速度增加10%
synergyUpgrades.runtimeNotes: 只增益属于已满足两人成组势力的武将，队伍中单独来自其他势力的成员不获得该增益。

synergyUpgrades.name: 四方来朝
synergyUpgrades.description: 三人分属魏蜀吴时，每种势力使全军伤害增加15%，共45%
synergyUpgrades.runtimeNotes: 本卡为传说强化，按势力数形成独立乘区1加3乘0.15等于1.45，不并入普通伤害加法池。可与诸葛亮、司马懿及一名吴将组成的卧龙冢虎并存；不放大破甲锥独立百分比附伤。

heroCombos.name: 借东风
heroCombos.description: 风牢与火带同区衔接，火带长度乘以1.5，持续2秒
heroCombos.runtimeNotes: 仅放大响应火带的长度，不同时放大宽度；两秒后回到本次无双快照的原范围，避免面积被误放大至2.25倍。

heroCombos.name: 义薄云天
heroCombos.description: 援军与刀波同区扫过，总伤害提高40%
heroCombos.runtimeNotes: 对发起援军已造成伤害的存活目标补发0.4倍实际伤害快照；响应刀波当前与后续伤害乘1.4。补偿不重新计算已经包含的易伤或减免。

heroCombos.name: 长坂坡守卫
heroCombos.description: 长坂怒吼击退提高至1.8倍，龙胆五穿锁定共同区域内目标
heroCombos.runtimeNotes: 发起怒吼已完成的实际击退补发0.8倍，后续击退乘1.8；响应穿刺至少五段并锁定共同区域内存活目标，逐段遵守同一施放命中次数上限。

heroCombos.name: 雷海箭雨
heroCombos.description: 三个幽雷落点重构为十字雷海，每圆覆盖面积提高40%
heroCombos.runtimeNotes: 以发起幽雷的三个真实落点建立每圆面积为原1.4倍的十字并集，只补命中扩大部分；沿用发起无双原命中记录与每敌最多一次的上限，不重复打击原已命中敌人。

heroCombos.name: 虎卫号令
heroCombos.description: 令旗圈内军营射程提高50%，持续2秒
heroCombos.runtimeNotes: 以响应令旗圈建立两秒射程效果；同类射程增益取最强值，不与其他射程光环重复叠乘。

heroCombos.name: 神箭突骑
heroCombos.description: 合肥冲锋伤害乘以1.6，并必定命中已被三矢标记的首领
heroCombos.runtimeNotes: 仅保证命中发起三矢真实命中过且仍存活的首领；普通冲锋的其他目标仍遵守当前施放形状与命中上限。

heroCombos.name: 火烧赤壁
heroCombos.description: 江东潮波伤害翻倍，真实潮波命中的目标再燃烧4秒
heroCombos.runtimeNotes: 对发起潮波真实命中过的存活目标补发一倍实际伤害快照；四秒燃烧使用响应周瑜本次P1快照的每跳伤害表、跳间隔与其武将伤害倍率，伤害归属发起孙权。

heroCombos.name: 独眼虎痴
heroCombos.description: 跃击与锥形重叠区域内的伤害提高50%
heroCombos.runtimeNotes: 在两技能实际重叠区域，对发起跃击已造成伤害的存活目标补发0.5倍实际伤害，响应锥形在重叠区域内乘1.5；区域外不获得该倍率。

comboRuntimeRules.runtimeNotes: 有向发起技能真实命中后，在战斗时间窗口内响应技能真实命中同一区域才触发。全部八组共享每局总次数；补偿不重吃快照中已有的易伤与减免，不补伤已死亡目标，不穿透当前无敌，也不生成新的合击触发记录。

10.name: 首位首领
10.description: 第10波迎来首位攻城首领，检验火力与城墙投资。

20.name: 疾行督骑
20.description: 疾行督骑在既有时机发动冲阵，加快对城门的压力。
20.runtimeNotes: 按权威曲线保留本波一名首领，替代旧稿双首领；复用既有每16秒触发4秒、速度乘1.4的技能，不提前添加新疾行。

25.name: 军旗潮
25.description: 军旗手成群出现，为步兵推进提供加速。
25.runtimeNotes: 指定军旗数量只在本波脚本精锐名额中重分配，不增加总人数、精锐总数或军粮预算。

30.name: 攻城车阵
30.description: 八台攻城车混入精锐，考验控制抗性与定向伤害。
30.runtimeNotes: 八台攻城车占用已有精锐名额，其余精锐重新分配；首领数和基础曲线保持脚本结果。

35.name: 扰阵弓手群
35.description: 扰阵弓手密集出现，营地需要应对连续干扰。
35.runtimeNotes: 弓手数量只在脚本精锐预算中重分配，不增加总人数、血量倍率或奖励。

40.name: 双坚壁守将
40.description: 两名坚壁守将全波保持四分之一减伤，考验攻坚能力。
40.runtimeNotes: 0.75为本波首领局部常驻减伤，与原技能减伤取最强而不相乘，不修改全局首领模板。

45.name: 兵海
45.description: 敌军集中涌入，待出兵队列保留所有溢出敌人。
45.runtimeNotes: 本波非首领出兵时刻统一为0.3秒；spawnWindowSec仍为脚本33.2秒，存活上限仍为160，溢出队列不丢弃敌人。

50.name: 三首领
50.description: 号令统领、坚壁守将与攻城统帅共同来袭。

60.name: 全兵种混编
60.description: 六类敌军与三名首领混编，检验完整构筑。
60.runtimeNotes: 所有数量、精锐占比、血量与首领数均继续由脚本公式推导。

70.name: 精锐潮
70.description: 精锐持续占据阵线，定向伤害与联动成为关键。
70.runtimeNotes: 严格使用脚本精锐比例0.38792；262名敌兵四舍五入为102名精锐，不把比例手改成0.39。

80.name: 目标终点
80.description: 三名首领与最终兵海到达设计目标，之后仍可继续挑战。
80.runtimeNotes: 第80波是目标软上限，突破后仍程序化生成新波，不在此处强行结束。

analysisModels.damagePerSecond: damage/intervalSec (single target, no travel or lost shots)
analysisModels.expectedAliveCount: spawnRatePerSec*averageResidenceSec before kills or leaks (Little's law approximation)
analysisModels.campReturnTimeSec: cost/(extraDps*effectiveDamageToFoodConversion); needs level composition and cannot be inferred from raw DPS alone
analysisModels.prototypeCountCompositionRule: i%11===7 -> cavalry from wave>=3; i%15===10 -> armor from wave>=4 overrides cavalry; boss added separately in final wave
analysisModels.notes: These are reproducible arithmetic models, not a V1 combat simulation.
analysisModels.executeRule: Only explicitly eligible infantry may be executed. All other enemies take bounded numeric damage, even if an early-level hit happens to kill them.

acceptanceTargets.note: Seed win fractions describe scripted strategies under randomized lane/choice conditions, not human win rates.

levelContract.schemaExtensionRule: Adding a hero, enemy, tactic or difficulty profile extends the named dictionaries; campaign count remains in level data.
levelContract.partySizePolicy: Bind party size at battle start and apply the selected explicit elite/boss HP multiplier once; never double-apply at group and wave levels.
levelContract.bossVariantHpMultiplierMeaning: act factor times explicit variant factor, excluding stage tier and party size

levelReferenceSchema.catalogEnumExtensionRule: Current hero/enemy/camp/growthTier entries reflect this manifest; append dictionary and tier entries with a future manifest instead of treating the sixty-level snapshot as an eternal cap.
